texts.about_this_item: Kotoffey natural wood cat litter made from pine and spruce wood, with no chemical or artificial additives. The wood granules absorb moisture quickly, swelling to three times their weight, and the natural wood scent helps remove unpleasant odours and makes litter training easier. Dust-free and does not stick to paws. Heat-treated.
